desc_en: public humiliation, wish you were dead

sequence.cn: 社死，全称叫社会性死亡。
sequence.en: 社死 is short for "social death".

sequence.cn: 人没有真的死，死的是你在别人面前的那张脸。
sequence.py: Rén méiyǒu zhēn de sǐ, sǐ de shì nǐ zài biéren miànqián de nà zhāng liǎn.
sequence.en: The person didn't actually die — what dies is the face you show to other people.

sequence.cn: 越想装作没事，越容易被人发现。
sequence.py: Yuè xiǎng zhuāng zuò méi shì, yuè róngyì bèi rén fāxiàn.
sequence.en: The harder you try to act normal, the easier it is to get caught.

sequence.cn: 上个月公司开季度会，二十多人，我要投屏做汇报。
sequence.py: Shàng ge yuè gōngsī kāi jìdù huì, èrshí duō rén, wǒ yào tóupíng zuò huìbào.
sequence.en: Last month my company had a quarterly meeting, twenty-plus people, and I was about to share my screen and present.

sequence.cn: 我一切屏，PPT没上去，倒是跟小张的聊天窗口出来了。
sequence.py: Wǒ yì qiē píng, PPT méi shàng qù, dào shì gēn Xiǎo Zhāng de liáotiān chuāngkǒu chūlái le.
sequence.en: The moment I switched screens, the slides didn't come up — instead my chat with Xiao Zhang did.

sequence.cn: 上面正好是那句话：李总这个方案，我真的看不下去。
sequence.py: Shàngmiàn zhènghǎo shì nà jù huà: Lǐ zǒng zhège fāng'àn, wǒ zhēn de kàn bu xiàqù.
sequence.en: And right there was that line: "Boss Li's proposal — I really can't stand looking at it."

sequence.cn: 我脸一下子红到了脖子，鼠标怎么按都关不掉那个窗口。
sequence.py: Wǒ liǎn yíxiàzi hóng dào le bózi, shǔbiāo zěnme àn dōu guān bu diào nàge chuāngkǒu.
sequence.en: My face went red all the way down to my neck; no matter how I clicked, that window wouldn't close.

sequence.cn: 会议室安静得能听见风扇的声音，小张也不敢看我。
sequence.py: Huìyìshì ānjìng de néng tīngjiàn fēngshàn de shēngyīn, Xiǎo Zhāng yě bù gǎn kàn wǒ.
sequence.en: The meeting room went so quiet you could hear the fan; even Xiao Zhang didn't dare look at me.

sequence.cn: 李总没生气，反而笑着说：十年前我也干过一模一样的事。
sequence.py: Lǐ zǒng méi shēngqì, fǎn'ér xiàozhe shuō: shí nián qián wǒ yě gàn guo yìmúyíyàng de shì.
sequence.en: Boss Li didn't get angry — instead he laughed: "Ten years ago I did the exact same thing."
